title: Meta reklāmu audits pirms Black Friday: 7 prompti vienai konta pārbaudei
seoTitle: Black Friday Meta reklāmu audits ar Claude | Mārketinga Skola
description: Septiņi Claude prompti, kas pirms Black Friday tikai nolasa Meta reklāmu datus: faktiskie pasūtījumi, apnikušas reklāmas, budžeta grafiks un apturēšana.
facts: The source is Rihards Zeila's own English guide (rihardszeila.com/blog/black-friday-meta-ads-audit), built on the rules he runs on his own account. Take its content, numbers, steps and the seven prompts; write the Latvian fresh, not sentence by sentence.
Never name the print-on-demand store, and never say or hint at what it sells, its theme or its niche: it is only 'a print-on-demand ecommerce project'.
Black Friday is Friday 27 November 2026. The safe budget ramp is +20 % every 3 days; four raises about double the budget; the last day to start the ramp is Sunday 15 November.
All seven prompts only read and report: they never change anything in the reader's ad account, and the reader makes every decision.

A single flat connecting line runs to the right into a month calendar panel for late November with a staircase of four rising navy bars climbing toward one marked date near the end of the month. The marked date is the only cyan element. Two panels side by side, drawn large and whole, the group spanning the full width with an even dark margin.
